author: marzuyo
quote: Beautiful open world, a lot of intractable things to witness, its like the world is truly alive around you, beautiful graphics and gameplay is fun, but the framerate is horrible, theres no antialiasing, visible noise, you are not allowed to go on your own way to do whatever you want like in gta V until 5 hours into the story, i would like it if it ran at a minimum of 60fps plus how do you expect a normal person to go oh that seems right, to 30fps and 206gb of storage needed
